summary: Closed O-043 to O-050 in tests/window/WindowCases.ps1: W-003 real mode now fails when Stop was pressed and no stopped ending came, and is inconclusive on a missed marker deadline. W-001 -Stopped fails at once on an attempt that timed out or left no report, and starts only after a finished run that ended Completed. W-002 no longer fails a scan that was not Completed, and the root classifier and lister now read a root as the app does (corpus tests/window/W001RootSpellingsCorpus.json). All 8 review repro tests were red before the change and are green after it, and each fix has a mutation that turns its test red. This pass fixed the one architecture-rule violation: W001RootSpellingCorpusTests now builds its fixture with the existing TempTree helper instead of Path.GetTempPath(). The full suite had 1259 passed and 1 failed before that edit, the failure being AppArgumentTests tripped by the engine's .taad-scratch task.ps1 files (lesson #889). It was not re-run after the fixture change. The SUBST W-001 -Stopped script held end to end; the maintainer's real C:\, OneDrive and share runs were not run.

files.why: O-043..O-050: Invoke-W001StoppedRun fails an attempt with no report or non-zero exit instead of retrying it; Test-W001 runs the stopped run only after a Completed finished run, and takes shape, whole-drive and record path from the root as the app reads it; Test-W002 drops the unconditional Completed check; Test-W003Real fails on Stop pressed with no ending and makes a refused marker Inconclusive; Get-W001RootShape and Get-ProofRecordPath follow LongPath.NormalizeRoot; Seam.AppRoot normalises the lister's root.
The corpus for the class 'root spellings taken as typed rather than as the app normalises them': 34 shape rows (letter, UNC, folder and refused spellings) and 10 listing rows.

Checks every corpus row's expected shape against LongPath.NormalizeRoot itself, then runs Get-W001RootShape, Get-ProofRecordPath and Seam.ListFiles over every row. The listing fixture is a TempTree, which the Core tests' %SystemRoot%\Temp rule allows.

obligations.how: Test-W003Real now calls Check $false when the marker was not refused, the hook's acted line exists and the app left no report or exited TIMEOUT. Get-ShareVerdict then returns 'failed' and the record verdict is 'failed'. $final is initialised so the finally block can always write the record. W003RealStopNoEndingReproTests failed before and passes now.

Invoke-W001StoppedRun checks every attempt right after Invoke-HookedRun: an exit other than '0' or no report sets $abnormal, calls Check $false and breaks, so no clean retry can turn it into 'held'. The 'none was partial' inconclusive is skipped for an abnormal run, and the stopped part is written 'failed' in the finally. W001StoppedTimeoutReproTests failed before and passes now.

Same change as O-044: only a run that ended with exit 0 and a report and was not partial is retried at half the count. A TIMEOUT or no-report attempt fails the case at once, and the old post-loop CheckEqual and Check on the last attempt were removed as redundant. W001StoppedRetryTests failed before and passes now.

In Test-W003Real the Write-Output for a refused marker is now Inconclusive with the same wording, so the case reports inconclusive and records no failure, and the record verdict is 'inconclusive'. W003MarkerRefusedReproTests failed before and passes now.

mutation.find: if ($refused) { Inconclusive 'W-003: the hook''s 60 s marker deadline
mutation.replace: if ($refused) { Write-Output 'W-003: the hook''s 60 s marker deadline

obligations.how: Test-W001 runs Invoke-W001StoppedRun only when the finished run's core.status is 'Completed'. Otherwise it prints 'no stopped run: the finished run did not end Completed' and writes no stopped part. W001StoppedAfterIncompleteReproTests failed before and passes now.

Deleted Test-W002's unconditional CheckEqual 'Completed' on core.status. A Refused, RootUnreadable or Cancelled scan now ends INCONCLUSIVE with 0 failures, matching Get-HydrationVerdict and the record; exit code and report presence keep their Checks. W002NotCompletedReproTests failed before and passes now.

mutation.replace: if ($null -ne $scan) { CheckEqual 'Completed' $scan.core.status 'core.status' } # No check of core.status here:

obligations.how: Get-W001RootShape now classes the root by the steps of LongPath.NormalizeRoot: it strips \\?\ and \\?\UNC\, turns a bare 'C:' into the drive, throws before scanning on a root the app refuses, runs GetFullPath, keeps one trailing separator on a drive or share root, then classes the result. Get-ProofRecordPath takes the letter from the root's own 'X:', with the extended prefix allowed, and throws otherwise. Test-W001 takes $wholeDrive from the shape ($shape -cne 'folder') and the record path from the same root, so the wcifs check and -Force guard see the right file. Corpus tests/window/W001RootSpellingsCorpus.json has 34 shape rows; W001RootSpellingCorpusTests checks each against LongPath.NormalizeRoot, and that check passed on the unfixed code, so no expectation is a guess. Before the fix 17 shape rows failed (S05 to S11, S13, S14, U03, U04, R01 to R06); after it all pass. A real run of -Case W-001 -Root X:/ over a SUBST drive gave rootShape local-letter, scope whole-drive, coverage required and the record at docs/proof-runs/w001-x-drive.json (removed afterwards).

Added Seam.AppRoot, the steps of LongPath.NormalizeRoot, and Seam.ListFiles now starts from AppRoot(root). So 'C:/x', 'C:\x\.', 'C:\x\a\..' and \\?\ forms list the folder the app scans. The corpus's 10 listing rows (same file as O-049) each list 2 files. Before the fix rows L04 to L08 listed 0. The test also asserts that LongPath.NormalizeRoot reads every spelling as the one tree. W002ListingRootSpellingTests failed before and passes now.

tests.command: mutation loop: each fix taken out in turn (7 replacements), its tests re-run with --no-build, the file then restored from its saved bytes
tests.note: Every mutation made its tests fail: O-043 1 failed, O-044/O-045 2 failed, O-046 1, O-047 1, O-048 1, O-049 2 (RootSpellingTests and the corpus), O-050 2 (ListingRootSpellingTests and the corpus). The file was restored afterwards.

Run through the real entry point. W-001 -Stopped on a SUBST letter over a 30,302-folder temp tree with 2 denied folders, using the published app: the finished part held with outcome completed and coverage figures. The stopped run was partial (acted at 17,602 folders, sized '-') and held, with 0 rows cut short. The record held no path and nothing was written under .taad. Exit 0 in 33 s. The record, SUBST, ACEs and tree were removed.

tests.command: pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/window/WindowCases.ps1 -Case W-001 -Root X:/ (X: SUBST over a tiny temp tree)
tests.note: The root spelled 'X:/' was classed local-letter, whole-drive, with coverage required. It wrote docs/proof-runs/w001-x-drive.json, verdict held, outcome completed, coverage present. The record, SUBST and tree were removed afterwards, and docs/proof-runs was removed because it did not exist before.

1259 passed, 1 failed (run before the TempTree fixture change). The failure is AppArgumentTests.EveryScriptThatLaunchesTheAppIsListedAndQuotesByTheRule, and its only offenders are the engine's own .taad-scratch/sandbox/run-*/in/task.ps1 files (lesson #889). It is not caused by this build, and I left the engine's scratch alone. The whole suite was not re-run after the fixture change.

24 of 24 passed after W001RootSpellingCorpusTests was changed to build its listing fixture with TempTree. git grep for the rule's Path.GetTempPath pattern over tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests/W00*.cs and W001*.cs found nothing. The Fitness engine's own re-check of this rule was not run here.
'All checks held.' The guard corpus, writer agreement and the last W-001 record are all quiet under the moved rule.
Printed nothing (exit 1), so the file holds no line naming the engine folder (Q-010, architecture rule 3).

not_built: The real runs stay the maintainer's: W-001 on C:\ (finished and -Stopped), W-002 on OneDrive, and W-003 on a real share. The W-002 rig run and the W-003 stall-rig run register a cldflt sync root and an SMB loopback mapping, so I did not run them here. Only the pure functions behind them are tested.
follow_ups: AppArgumentTests fails whenever the engine's .taad-scratch/sandbox/**/task.ps1 files are in the tree (lesson #889); the engine should write its scratch outside the repository or the test should skip .taad-scratch.
Waived as N-036: Test-W003Real's seconds-since-launch counter never shows, because [Console]::In.ReadLineAsync blocks. Fix it when a real W-003 run shows it matters.
Waived as N-035: 'refused-another-code' also fires for network and device errors raised before any access check, which can read as a false C4 failure on a network-letter or UNC W-001 root.
